purpose: Crop-to-climate-zone yield potential, risk level and the dominant climatic risk.
collection_mode: Knowledge synthesis from documented public sources (WebFetch to government domains blocked by environment egress policy)
methodology: Every crop carries two rows (primary and secondary zone), giving 90 mappings. primary_climatic_risk names the specific failure mode that matters for that crop in that zone, which is the field of actual operational value.
known_limitations: yield_potential is a relative agro-climatic rating (Optimal/Good/Marginal), deliberately not a tonnage, because zone-level tonnage cannot be asserted from public sources without district qualification.
